description:
Meet the 2025 Ram 3500 Limited, a heavy-duty truck built to handle serious work while delivering refined comfort and capability. This White exterior model combines professional-grade performance with premium amenities, making it an ideal choice for those who demand both strength and sophistication in their work truck.

- 6.7L I6 Diesel Engine with 8-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 14.4" Display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- harman/kardon® Premium Audio with 17 Speakers
- Ultra Premium Leather Seats with Heating and Ventilation
- Power Sunroof
- Surround View Camera System with ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Dual Wireless Charging Pads
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Active Lane Management and Drowsy Driver Detection
- Power Deployable Running Boards
- MOPAR Spray-In Bedliner
- Dual Rear Wheels with 6000# Front Axle
- Auto Level Rear Air Suspension
- 50 Gallon Fuel Tank

The cabin reflects the Limited trim's commitment to luxury, featuring ultra-premium leather appointments throughout. The 8-way power-adjustable driver and passenger seats offer heating, ventilation, and lumbar support for all-day comfort. Genuine wood trim on the dashboard, door panels, and console insert adds warmth and sophistication. The full-length premium console provides convenient storage, while dual wireless charging pads keep your devices ready for use.

Technology integration is seamless with Uconnect 5 Navigation displaying on a 14.4-inch touchscreen. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity ensures your smartphone integrates naturally with the truck's interface. The harman/kardon® audio system with 17 speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio delivers superior sound quality whether you're working or traveling. Voice controls via steering wheel-mounted buttons keep your hands on the wheel and eyes on the road.

Safety features provide comprehensive protection for you and your passengers. The system includes adaptive steering, active lane management, drowsy driver detection, and traffic sign recognition. Multiple airbags, including front and side impact protection, work in concert with ABS brakes and electronic stability control. The surround view camera system with rear backup camera and cargo view gives you complete visibility during maneuvering.

On the road, the 6.7L I6 diesel engine paired with the 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers the capability this class demands. Auto level rear air suspension maintains a level ride whether fully loaded or empty. Trailer tire pressure monitoring and reverse guidance assist with towing operations. The dual rear wheels provide stability and load capacity for serious hauling.

From the sport performance hood to the LED bed lighting, from power deployable running boards to the MOPAR spray-in bedliner, every detail has been considered for both function and appearance. The Night Edition package combines black badging and grille with premium styling touches that set this truck apart.

This 2025 Ram 3500 Limited represents the intersection of working capability and refined comfort. We invite you to experience it yourself at our showroom and discover why this truck delivers the dependability and luxury you're looking for.

description: FUTURISTIC, WELL-EQUIPPED, ONE-OWNER, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, UNLIKE ANYTHING ELSE ON THE ROAD! The 2025 Tesla Cybertruck remains the most talked-about vehicle in America, and this AWD example shows exactly why it's earned that reputation. Finished in its signature bare Stainless Steel exterior and showing 11,177 miles, this Cybertruck pairs genuinely quick dual-motor acceleration with a level of engineering ambition no other production pickup on the market attempts to match. Buyers choose the Cybertruck specifically because nothing else looks, drives, or charges quite like it, from its nearly bulletproof body panels to its genuinely quick acceleration for a full-size pickup. Owners consistently point to the Cybertruck's one-pedal driving feel, surprisingly refined ride, and continuously improving software as reasons the ownership experience feels fundamentally different from any gas truck they've owned. That combination of genuine innovation and real everyday usability is exactly why the Cybertruck remains one of the most requested vehicles on the market, even well after its initial launch hype. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION The Cybertruck has drawn intensely polarized reviews for its design, but reviewers consistently agree on its genuinely impressive driving dynamics, one-pedal control, and comfortable, upscale-feeling cabin. IIHS Top Safety Pick (2025-26 models built after April 2025) NHTSA 5-Star Overall Safety Rating Golden Steering Wheel Coolest Car Award (2024, Bild am Sonntag and Auto Bild) WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 11,177-mile mark, and this Cybertruck is STILL COVERED under Tesla's full transferable factory coverage. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage Basic Vehicle Limited Warranty -- Covers virtually all vehicle components against defects in material or workmanship. Expiration: 06/30/2029 or 50,000 miles, whichever comes first. Supplemental Restraint System Limited Warranty -- Covers the seat belts and airbag system. Expiration: 06/30/2030 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. Battery and Drive Unit Limited Warranty -- Covers the high-voltage battery pack and electric drive units, including a guarantee of at least 70 percent battery capacity retention. Expiration: 06/30/2033 or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first. Body Rust Limited Warranty -- Covers rust perforation on body panels. Expiration: 06/30/2037, unlimited miles. A premium audio system, heat pump-based cabin heating, and an AMD Ryzen-powered infotainment processor give this truck a level of cabin technology unmatched by traditional pickups. Onboard power outlets in both the front trunk and bed, along with dedicated power feed points, turn this Cybertruck into a genuinely useful mobile power source for job sites, tailgates, or camping. CHARGING, RANGE & ELECTRIFIED POWERTRAIN This Cybertruck AWD is EPA-rated for genuinely competitive range for a full-size electric pickup, giving owners real flexibility for daily driving without range anxiety becoming part of the conversation. Home charging on a Level 2 connection comfortably replenishes a full charge overnight, making daily refueling as simple as plugging in before bed. For longer trips, this Cybertruck has access to Tesla's extensive Supercharger network and supports 3rd-party NACS DC fast charging as well, adding substantial range in a fraction of the time a Level 2 charger would take and keeping road trips genuinely practical. TRUCK CAPABILITY This Cybertruck isn't just built to look like a truck -- it brings serious working capability to the table. Tesla rates the AWD model to tow up to 11,000 pounds, with a maximum trailer tongue weight of 1,100 pounds, giving it the muscle to handle substantial boats, campers, equipment trailers, and recreational toys. Depending on tire configuration, Tesla rates maximum payload at up to 2,500 pounds, putting real hauling ability behind the Cybertruck's unconventional design. Its usefulness goes well beyond the headline numbers. The enclosed cargo bed provides approximately 56.1 cubic feet of above-floor storage, complemented by a 3.4-cubic-foot under-bed storage compartment and 7.1-cubic-foot front trunk. Tesla rates the front trunk itself to support as much as 441 pounds, while the under-bed compartment can support up to 220 pounds. This Cybertruck's towing capability is backed by dedicated trailer technology confirmed available through the vehicle's own systems, including trailer profiles, trailer auxiliary power and trailer-specific energy-consumption calculations. Adaptive air suspension, a locking rear differential, and adjustable ride height further give it the hardware to handle heavy-duty recreation, hauling, and rougher terrain with confidence. MECHANICAL FEATURES This Cybertruck's dual-motor all-wheel-drive system delivers the instant, seamless torque that's become a hallmark of Tesla's powertrains, with genuinely quick acceleration that catches most drivers off guard the first time they experience it. The locking rear differential and selectable Off-Road drive mode add real confidence when conditions get slippery or the pavement runs out entirely. Adaptive air suspension continuously adjusts ride height and damping based on driving conditions, giving this Cybertruck a noticeably more composed, comfortable ride than its rugged exterior might suggest. EXTERIOR FEATURES Finished in its signature bare Stainless Steel exterior, this Cybertruck wears a finish unlike anything else on the road, one that's designed to age and patina naturally over time rather than requiring traditional paint upkeep. The angular, exoskeleton body panels and full-width LED lighting signature give this truck a road presence that's impossible to mistake for anything else. The powered tonneau cover keeps the bed's contents secure and shielded from the weather, while the substantial all-terrain tires add both capability and visual presence. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, the minimalist cabin centers around Tesla's signature yoke steering wheel and a large central touchscreen, creating an environment that feels more like a technology showcase than a traditional pickup interior. A dedicated rear-seat touchscreen and genuinely comfortable rear seating make this Cybertruck a legitimately usable family vehicle, not just a technology demonstration. CyberTent Mode and the truck's onboard outlet system make this Cybertruck ready for camping or off-grid use straight from the factory, a genuinely unique trait among full-size pickups. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY An AMD Ryzen-powered infotainment processor drives a large, responsive touchscreen that handles navigation, media, and vehicle settings with the kind of speed and polish more commonly found in consumer electronics than pickup trucks. Premium Connectivity brings satellite-view maps with live traffic, video and music streaming, and internet browsing over Wi-Fi and cellular. Subscription may be required to maintain service. This Cybertruck also comes equipped with Full Self-Driving (Supervised) capability. Purchaser should verify current subscription/activation status with Tesla before relying on this feature. SAFETY FEATURES Standard Traffic-Aware Cruise Control uses this Cybertruck's camera suite to help manage speed and following distance, while a comprehensive suite of collision-avoidance technology, including Automatic Emergency Braking and Forward Collision Warning, works quietly in the background on every drive. Emergency Lane Departure Avoidance and Obstacle-Aware Acceleration add further layers of protection. Power door locks include anti-lockout and auto-locking functions, adding convenience and security. 2021 Ford F-150 Raptor 4x4 SuperCrew 450HP High-Output EcoBoost Only 23,122 Miles

THIS IS NOT YOUR AVERAGE F-150. Check out this absolutely BAD ASS 2021 Ford F-150 Raptor SuperCrew 4x4 with only 23,122 miles, finished in Oxford White over Black leather bucket seats. The Raptor is Ford Performance's purpose-built, high-speed off-road monsterand this one came loaded with an incredible $78,210 original MSRP.

Under the hood is the heart of the beast: Ford's 3.5L High-Output EcoBoost V6, pumping out a factory-rated 450 horsepower and 510 lb-ft of torque. It's backed by a 10-speed automatic transmission, electronic locking 4.10 rear axle, Torsen front differential, selectable drive modes, and Ford's serious Raptor-specific 4x4 hardware. This truck was engineered to hammer through terrain that would have ordinary pickups begging for mercy.

And the suspension is where the Raptor really separates itself from a regular lifted truck. You get FOX Live Valve shocks, 5-link rear suspension, Raptor-specific suspension tuning, skid plates, and serious ground clearance. It has the aggressive stance everyone wants from a modified truck, except Ford Performance engineered the entire package from the factory.

This one is loaded with Equipment Group 801A, a massive $5,355 package, plus the Raptor Series, Torsen Package, Convenience Package, Interior Work Surface, partitioned lockable storage, integrated trailer brake controller, 360-degree camera system, and more. It also has the upgraded 17-inch forged aluminum wheels, a $1,895 factory option, wrapped in the aggressive Raptor off-road tire setup.

Inside, this beast is surprisingly luxurious. You get Black leather bucket seats, heated and ventilated front seats, heated steering wheel, power-adjustable pedals, driver memory, dual-zone automatic climate control, power sliding rear window, SYNC 4 with 12-inch touchscreen, connected navigation, SiriusXM, wireless connectivity, and the 18-speaker B&O Unleashed sound system. There's even Pro Power Onboard 2kW, turning the truck into a mobile power source when you need it.

It looks every bit as mean as it performs with the unmistakable FORD Performance Raptor grille, unique Raptor bumpers, flared bodywork, running boards, LED lighting, dual exhaust with active valves, power tailgate lock, and those forged wheels. There is absolutely no mistaking this thing for a standard F-150 when it comes rolling down the road.

Safety and driver technology include Adaptive Cruise Control, 360-Degree Camera, Reverse Sensing System, Pre-Collision Assist, Blind Spot Information System, Lane-Keeping technology, AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, and a rearview camera.

If you've been shopping our lifted trucks because you want something that sits right, looks nasty, and has the hardware to back up the attitude, this Raptor takes that formula to another level. 450 horsepower, FOX Live Valve suspension, Torsen front differential, 4.10 electronic locker, forged wheels, active exhaust, 4x4, luxury interior, and only 23K milesthis truck is an absolute animal.

With a legendary Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Diesel engine delivering commanding capability and a 10-speed automatic transmission, this truck handles whatever you demand. - FX4 Off-Road Package with off-road tuned shock absorbers and Hill Descent Control

The Platinum trim reflects Ford's commitment to quality and feature-rich appointments. From lane-keeping alert technology to 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS, this truck combines modern safety innovations with proven durability. The 110V/400W outlet adds practical convenience for jobsite or campsite use.

Whether you're towing a gooseneck trailer or exploring remote terrain, this F-250SD Platinum delivers capability, comfort, and confidence. Visit us today and experience why this truck commands respect on every road and job site.

This 1-OWNER 1995 Ford F-350 XLT Crew Cab Long Bed 4x4 is a clean, well-kept example of the final-year OBS Ford platform, powered by the legendary 7.3L Power Stroke turbo diesel V8 paired with the highly desirable ZF5 5-speed manual transmission and 4-wheel drive. Known for its durability, pre-emissions simplicity, and long-term reliability, the 7.3L remains one of the most respected diesel engines ever produced. Combined with the manual transmission, this truck offers a driving experience and level of driver engagement that has become increasingly difficult to find. With 161,809 miles, this F-350 reflects careful ownership, thoughtful maintenance, and strong overall presentation.

Finished in Oxford White, this truck presents exceptionally well and retains the classic styling that helped define the OBS Ford era. The exterior is clean and straight with a bright finish and excellent overall appearance. A subtle 2-inch lift provides an improved stance while maintaining factory-like drivability. It rides on 16-inch OEM Alcoa wheels wrapped in BF Goodrich All-Terrain K03 tires sized 285/75R16, giving the truck a period-correct look with excellent all-terrain capability.

The gray cloth interior is in immaculate condition and presents remarkably well throughout. The seating surfaces, carpeting, dashboard, and trim all reflect careful ownership and preservation. As expected from a well-kept XLT, the cabin remains clean, functional, and comfortable while maintaining its original character. The overall presentation of the interior is impressive and far better than typically expected for the mileage.

Performance upgrades are limited to a K&N intake system, maintaining the truck’s largely stock nature while allowing improved airflow. The focus of this truck has clearly been on preservation and maintenance rather than extensive modification.

Mechanically, this F-350 runs and drives excellent with strong power delivery, smooth operation, and a tight, confident feel on the road. Extensive recent service has been completed to ensure reliability and drivability. Suspension and steering maintenance includes new Bilstein 4600 series shocks, all four tie rods, and a fresh alignment. The braking system has been comprehensively refreshed with new front rotors, pads, and calipers, along with new rear drums, shoes, and hardware. Fuel system service includes removal and cleaning of both fuel tanks, new sending units, and a new mechanical fuel pump. Additional maintenance includes a coolant system flush, new coolant reservoir, vacuum pump and pulley, alternator, A/C compressor with complete A/C service, serpentine belt, tensioner, and idler pulley. The result is a truck that feels exceptionally well sorted and ready for continued use.

Exterior condition is immaculate overall, with a clean, straight body and excellent paint presentation. The interior remains equally impressive, reflecting the level of care this truck has received throughout its life.

A clean, well-maintained OBS F-350 that combines the proven reliability of the 7.3L Power Stroke platform with the highly sought-after ZF5 manual transmission, tasteful upgrades, and extensive recent service.

Manual-transmission 7.3L OBS trucks continue to be among the most desirable configurations Ford produced, and examples with this level of maintenance and presentation are becoming increasingly difficult to find.

This XLT SuperCrew blends robust twin-turbo power with four-wheel drive capability and a roomy 6.5-foot bed, offering confident towing and responsive acceleration while delivering sensible fuel efficiency for a V6-powered full-size truck.

Wireless SYNC 4 AppLink with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps your favorite apps, calls and maps easily available without fumbling for a cable, making connectivity seamless on the road.

Front pedestrian impact prevention continuously monitors the roadway to spot pedestrians and can intervene to help avoid collisions, adding an important layer of protection in crowded or urban settings.

An integrated mobile hotspot provides on-the-go Wi-Fi so passengers can stream, work, or stay connected without draining phone data during long trips.

The rear camera gives you an enhanced view behind the truck to simplify parking, trailer hookup and reversing with greater confidence.

Lane departure prevention helps keep the truck centered in its lane by taking corrective action if an unintentional drift is detected, helping reduce the chance of lane-related incidents.

Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to detect a potential rear impact and prepares the vehicle and occupants, assisting in reducing the severity of a collision.

Brake assist senses emergency braking situations and applies extra stopping force when needed, helping shorten stopping distances in critical moments.

Cruise control with steering-wheel mounted controls lets you set and adjust speed without taking your hands off the wheel, easing fatigue on long highway drives and helping maintain steady efficiency.

A responsive touchscreen places infotainment and vehicle controls at your fingertips, streamlining operation and keeping essential information easy to read.

Full-time 4-wheel drive delivers improved traction in wet, snowy or loose conditions so you can tackle adverse surfaces with more confidence and composure.

Part-time 4-wheel/all-wheel drive gives you the flexibility to engage full traction when conditions demand it while avoiding unnecessary driveline strain during normal driving.

The 2026 F-150 XLT 4WD SuperCrew balances work-ready capability with modern convenience and safety technology. If you want a roomy, powerful truck that also looks after passengers and cargo, contact us to learn more, check towing details, or schedule a test drive.

This 2023 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LTZ in striking Radiant Red Tintcoat delivers the capability and comfort you need, whether you're tackling work or enjoying the open road.

- Power-Retractable Assist Steps with rearward articulation for convenient bed access
- Z71 Off-Road and Protection Package with off-road suspension and Hill Descent Control
- 3.0L I-6 Diesel Turbocharged Duramax engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- Chevytec spray-on black bedliner for bed protection
- Premium Bose 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM 360L
- 12.3" multicolor reconfigurable digital display
- Wireless phone projection with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Keyless open and start system
- 10-way power driver and passenger seats with lumbar support and heating
- Heated and ventilated front seats
- HD surround vision with hitch guidance and integrated trailer brake controller
- All-terrain tires on 20-inch aluminum wheels
- 275/60R20 all-terrain blackwall tires
- Wireless charging pad
- Engine block heater for reliable cold-weather starts

Built on the Z71 Off-Road and Protection Package platform, this truck is equipped to handle rugged terrain with confidence. The suspension is specifically tuned for off-road performance, while Hill Descent Control adds an extra layer of control on challenging descents. Skid plates protect vital undercarriage components, and the heavy-duty air filter ensures your engine performs at its best in demanding conditions.

Inside, the LTZ cabin prioritizes your comfort and connectivity. The leather-appointed front seats offer heating and ventilation, adjustable lumbar support, and memory functions that personalize your driving position. The wireless charging pad keeps your devices powered, while the multicolor digital display provides all the information you need at a glance. Premium Bose audio takes your drive to the next level with crisp, detailed sound whether you're streaming music or enjoying SiriusXM satellite radio.

The truck's technology suite makes towing and trailering straightforward. The integrated trailer brake controller works seamlessly with the hitch guidance system, which includes hitch view to help you align perfectly every time. The trailering app lets you monitor and manage your setup from your smartphone, giving you peace of mind whether you're at home or on the road.

With 22 city MPG and 27 highway MPG, the turbocharged diesel engine balances power with efficiency. The 10-speed automatic transmission keeps the engine in its optimal operating range, and the 220-amp alternator ensures ample charging capacity for any electrical demands.

Every detail of this Silverado reflects Chevrolet's commitment to quality and durability. The spray-on bedliner protects your cargo area from the elements, while the all-weather floor liners keep your interior protected. Chrome mirror caps, front LED fog lamps, and a rear step bumper complete the refined exterior appearance.

Come experience this 2023 Silverado 1500 LTZ and discover why it's the right choice for your next truck.
